notes:
June 1st 2026
Version 10.8+ (stable) / 10.9+(beta)
**********************
NEW!
* New one-click "Sync from Accordion" button on the main screen pulls the accordion's current configuration with a single click. (R)
* New "Status" master toggle for Function Switches on FR-4x makes button assignments easier to manage. (R)
* Function Switch register labels on FR-4x now match the accordion's actual register table. (R)
* New Layout configuration tab for FR-4x (Bass & Chord Mode + Free Bass Mode + Treble Mode). (R)
* Broader and deeper FR-4x support across MIDI, Layout, and tone querying. (R)
* New MIDI Filters panel with per-section toggles for Note, CC, PC, Volume, Pan, Reverb, Chorus, and Sustain transmission. (R)
* New Expression MIDI Tx panel with per-section toggles. (R)
* New Start/Stop Tx toggle for MIDI clock transmission. (R)
* New Organ Aftertouch Tx toggle (FR-8x). (R)
* Automatic per-model MIDI parameter routing — K-Config now sends the right paramIDs for FR-4x vs FR-8x without any user setup. (R)
* New on-hover tooltips throughout Global Settings show the accordion's LCD short-names for easy cross-reference. (R)
* Clearer label for the 2nd Bass MIDI Out control. (R)
* Improved accuracy of reverb, chorus, and delay type names in Set Common. (R)
* Clearer "Reed Range" labeling on the bass, chord, and freebass editors. (R)
* Consistent naming across all section editors. (R)
* Polished labels and tooltips throughout the FR-Editor. (R)
* Labels and section names aligned with the user manual + page references for easy cross-reference. (R)
* Smarter handling of multiple app launches keeps your edits safe. (R K)
* Friendlier feedback when the accordion isn't responding. (R)
* Your saved expansion-pack Settings stay safe even if the accordion disconnects mid-Sync. (R)
* Smoother experience when picking tones from the K-Editor search dropdowns. (K)
* Smoother experience when switching tabs in the Live Editor during a Read. (R)
* Clearer "Download Latest Software" button label in the Subscribe / Activate dialog. (R K)
* New UPG Integrity Check tool — recursively validates Roland files in any folder (USB root, project folder, anywhere). Results shown as a sortable per-file table. (R)
* Right-click any Roland tree → "Validate Entire Tree" for an instant integrity check. (R)
* Shared UPG Repository upload now protects against uploading corrupt files. (R)
* Live UPG Editor → Import .UPG protects against pushing corrupt files to the accordion. (R)
* Automatic background validation of every UPG load in Live Editor — any issues surface in your diagnostic log automatically. (R)
* F.Bass section editor: new "Noise / Growl / Effects" tab for Reed Growl, Button Noise, Reverb/Chorus/Delay sends, and Detune. (R)
* Orch Bass section: new "Drum Link" tab for assigning drum hits that trigger alongside left-hand bass notes. (R)
* Live Editor Master Tune tab reads current accordion values when you open the tab, so Send respects your live LCD-configured settings. (R)
* Master Tune protects your in-progress edits from being overwritten by the background auto-Read. (R)
* Cleaner "unsaved changes" tracking — no more false markers on the Active Sections page in layered states. (R)
* Release Notes window redesigned with the modern dark theme — date headers, dividers, and color-coded R/K chips for easy scanning. (R K)
* Three more dialogs modernized to the consistent dark theme — UPG Detail popup, Roland Settings, and Tone List Query. (R)
* More polished dialog appearance and reliability on macOS. (R K)
* General stability improvements across editors, dialogs, and PDF downloads. (R K)
* Live UPG Editor: Export to .UPG, Export to .UPB, and Load/Test .UPG are now visible on stable too (previously beta-only). Toggle with Ctrl+Shift+Alt+1 (Cmd+Shift+Opt+1 on macOS). (R)
* FR-4x Live Editor: fixed Load reliability when navigating to a different bank while keeping the same register number — accordion's Working Area now updates correctly. (R)
* Install reliability: launching K-Configurator now reliably runs the freshly-installed version. Previously, if an older copy was still running in the background, the new copy would silently raise the old window instead of starting fresh — users sometimes thought updates hadn't installed. Now the new launch cleanly closes any prior instance and starts the just-installed version. (R K)
